name: protendai/nativephp-wifi-direct
description: Wi-Fi Direct for NativePHP Mobile: phone-to-phone networking with no router, with built-in QR pairing. Android hosts and joins; iOS joins an Android phone's group.

bridge_functions.name: WifiDirect.Status
bridge_functions.description: Capabilities and current state (supported, canHost, enabled, fiveGhz, permission, wifiJoined, connected, isGroupOwner, groupOwnerIp). Synchronous.

bridge_functions.name: WifiDirect.RequestPermission
bridge_functions.description: Ask for Nearby Wi-Fi devices (Android 13+) or location (Android 10-12). Async: PermissionResult.

bridge_functions.name: WifiDirect.CreateGroup
bridge_functions.description: Host a group (Android only). Async: GroupCreated or ConnectionFailed within timeoutSeconds.

bridge_functions.name: WifiDirect.Connect
bridge_functions.description: Join a group by network name and passphrase without a system dialog (Android) or as a Wi-Fi client (iOS). Async: Connected or ConnectionFailed. Malformed credentials return ok:false and fire no event.

bridge_functions.name: WifiDirect.Disconnect
bridge_functions.description: Leave or tear down the group and cancel anything in flight. Async: Disconnected (always).

bridge_functions.name: WifiDirect.QrCode
bridge_functions.description: Render text as a QR code PNG. Synchronous.

bridge_functions.name: WifiDirect.ScanQr
bridge_functions.description: Open a QR code scanner. Async: QrScanned or QrScanCancelled.

info_plist.NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera is used to scan pairing codes shown by nearby devices.
info_plist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Used to connect directly to nearby devices to exchange data.
